header.name: InvUI Phase 0 Probe (DISPOSABLE WORLD ONLY)
header.description: WARNING: Experimental VirtualContainer probe. DISPOSABLE TEST WORLD ONLY. Not for production, shared, or distribution use. Ships NO JSON UI / input bridge. Items are deliberately unprotected and can be taken. Fill is REFUSED while viewers exist because open-screen setItem can duplicate items. itemChange is logged as DANGER and close/dump accounting mismatches STOP the probe. Virtual container contents are NOT saved and are lost on reload/shutdown/disable: never store valuables or real items in it. Verify regular chests before and after.
